description: Cookiebot CMP uc.js loader identity and optional query settings. Official support permits data attributes to be moved to query parameters without the data- prefix. Settings may remain on the HTML tag. Culture and account/runtime configuration stay external; declaration rendering is vendor/cookiebot-declaration.

params.name: cbid
params.description: It is the Cookiebot domain group ID. Cookiebot documents uc.js?cbid= as one install. The other install puts the same UUID in data-cbid, not the query.
params.fix_hint: For a query install, put the domain group ID on the URL as cbid=. For a tag-attribute install, data-cbid carries it instead.

params.name: type
params.description: Documented dialog-type override. The loader passes nonempty query values to the banner without changing case.
params.fix_hint: Use a documented dialog type, or omit the override to use the account or HTML configuration.

params.name: level
params.description: Documented consent-level override. The loader passes nonempty query values to the banner without changing case.
params.fix_hint: Use implied or strict, or omit the override to use the account or HTML configuration.

params.name: framework
params.description: The pinned 2.140.0 loader accepts these case-insensitive framework aliases and normalizes them to its current TCF implementation. The current support guide recommends TCF; the older developer table names IAB.
params.fix_hint: Use framework=TCF for the current documented integration, or a supported legacy alias. HTML data-framework remains a separate carrier.

params.name: blockingmode
params.description: Documented automatic or manual cookie blocking. The loader compares auto without case sensitivity; none and omission preserve manual behavior.
params.fix_hint: Use auto for automatic blocking or none for manual markup, or carry the setting in data-blockingmode.

params.name: consentmode
params.description: Documented Google Consent Mode disable override. The loader accepts disabled without case sensitivity. Omission preserves the configured default.
params.fix_hint: Use disabled to disable Google Consent Mode, or omit this override.

params.name: consentmode-dataredaction
params.description: The pinned 2.140.0 loader reads this exact query key or the data-consentmode-dataredaction attribute and explicitly warns for other populated values. The accepted strings are case-sensitive.
params.fix_hint: Use true, false or dynamic, or omit the override to retain the configured value.
